name: Surya
source:
Lady Surya is the manager of Surya District, the district you live in. She's a cheerful and hardworking fluff. She's usually busy with work, but always tries to find time to find time to organize events and have fun with everyone.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
